# The imperial nails of `//pub/std/fastener/nail/imperial`

Every size, as ASTM F1667 and the federal specification it replaced
(FF-N-105B) state it. Each part is `//pub/std/fastener/nail/imperial:<family>/<size>`.
Lengths and diameters are in inches, as the tables give them; the parts carry
them in millimetres. "Point" is the `nail-point` interface the nail implements,
which decides where it fits. "8d / 6d" is the pointside penetration EN 1995-1-1
asks of it, smooth and profiled. "Per lb" is the source's approximate count per
pound, for a bright smooth nail. See [CLASSIFICATION.md](CLASSIFICATION.md) for
what the columns mean and [README_imperial.md](README_imperial.md) for the
families.
